findings.summary_claim: The Base animal ability clarifications omit Pack entirely; line 290 delegates amounts to cards but never defines this supplied ability.

primary_evidence.quote: A predator with Pack (Gain 1 appeal for each predator icon in your zoo.) gains you 1 additional appeal, even if you do not have another predator in your zoo.

primary_evidence.evidence: The illustrated Lion has Pack 1: Gain 1 appeal per predator icon in your zoo.

findings.correct_rule: Pack grants 1 additional appeal per predator icon in your own zoo, counting the newly played animal itself. This is a play benefit, not a trigger for future predators.
findings.why_unresolved: This is an expressly printed normal base animal procedure in the supplied English packet, rather than an unavailable card ability inferred from outside sources. The summary includes other illustrated abilities but omits Pack.

findings.summary_claim: Project support is described generically as taking the depicted award, but the supplied illustrated project tables (other than Species Diversity at line 277) are not recorded.

primary_evidence.evidence: Reptiles illustrated card: requires 5 / 4 / 2 reptile icons for 5 / 4 / 2 conservation respectively.

primary_evidence.quote: Since you have 3 large animals in your zoo ... For this you gain 3 conservation project points.
primary_evidence.evidence: Large Animals illustrated table has 4 / 3 / 2 large animals for 4 / 3 / 2 conservation. Aquatic illustrated table has 5 / 4 / 2 water icons for 4 / 3 / 2 conservation.
Serengeti National Park illustrated table: release Africa animal of printed standard size 4+ / 3 / 2− for 5 / 4 / 3 conservation; playing the card grants 1 reputation.

findings.correct_rule: For the illustrated Reptiles project, 5/4/2 icons pay 5/4/2 conservation. For illustrated Large Animals, 4/3/2 large animals pay 4/3/2 conservation. For illustrated Aquatic, 5/4/2 water icons pay 4/3/2 conservation. For the illustrated Africa release project, printed sizes 4+/3/2− pay 5/4/3 conservation, and playing a new release project grants 1 reputation. All remain subject to the summary’s correctly stated free-level and once-per-project limits.
findings.why_unresolved: These are supplied printed reward/condition tables and one explicit procedural example, not missing unsupplied full-deck data. The generic direction to use a card is workable during play, but does not provide complete coverage of these supplied tables under this audit’s strict completeness standard.

source_boundary_limitations: Original English main v1.2 is controlling; the glossary and official FAQ clarify it. German publisher photos supplement numeric original component diagrams only; no German prose edition was used.

Optional solo rules on main page20, solo-only card substitutions as solo gameplay, glossary solo scoring exception and FAQ solo-break answer were excluded; the authorized multiplayer choice to substitute solo card effects is covered.
Marine Worlds, promos, map packs, strategy guide and any other external assets are excluded.

Full original card deck and high-resolution standalone advanced maps are not supplied. No unseen card costs, conditions or abilities, or unseen full advanced map text/bonuses, were inferred. Map3’s main ability and Commercial Harbor’s exact printed sale payoff cannot be reconstructed from the supplied prose and are boundary limitations, not asserted omissions.
The printed procedures and legible illustrated cards/tables actually present in these sources remain in scope; findings F01–F02 concern such present evidence.

The BGG identifier, summary extraction/verification metadata and the assertion of prior verification cannot be independently authenticated from this gameplay source packet. No prior verification claim was accepted as evidence.

Low-resolution embedded illustrations can limit complete per-card stat transcription. Enlargements were used for all summary-dependent tiny tables/effects; this is not a certification of every unseen card in the product.
